confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live prices or listings were checked. Lodging is the least certain, given July high-season swings. Examples assume roughly 4,000 COP per USD. Cocktail and wine are set at about 3x and 2.5x the beer anchor, since direct price knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The regional basis is general knowledge of Colombian Caribbean tourist pricing, with a July high-season uplift on lodging.
